p: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses,
a: so I will be with thee
s: : I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

p: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do

s: , which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.

p: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God,
a: he is God in heaven above

p: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and

the stars of heaven in their courses
the host of heaven in the height

p: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you,

p: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which

p: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD,

p: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that

p: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer,

s: : behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.

p: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD
a: with all his heart
s: , and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.

p: Give thanks unto the LORD,

s: , make known his deeds among the people.

a: Glory ye in his holy name
s: : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
d: Rejoice in the God of our salvation

p: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations,
a: The LORD reigneth

p: O LORD,
a: there is none like thee
s: , neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

p: Now
a: set your heart and your soul
s: to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.

p: And David said to Solomon his son,

s: , and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
d: Stand fast in the righteous faith
Trust in the God of our fathers
Fear not the face of any king

a: Both riches and honour come of thee
s: , and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
d: Great wisdom and power belong to God
Salvation and peace are in thy hand
Thy righteousness shineth as the sun

a: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee
s: ; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
d: Riches and honor shall follow thy throne
Great peace and victory are in thy hand
Length of days and health are thy portion

p: Wherefore now let
a: the fear of the LORD
s: be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

p: And said, O LORD God of our fathers,
a: art not thou God in heaven?
s: and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?
d: dost thou not judge the earth?

p: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and

d: behold the glory of his arm
know the peace of his presence
praise the majesty of his grace

p: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem;
a: Believe in the LORD your God
s: , so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.

p: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should
a: praise the beauty of holiness
s: , as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy endureth for ever.
d: sing unto the Lord with joy

p: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up
a: to his holy dwelling place
s: , even unto heaven.

p: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them
a: whose spirit God had raised
s: , to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.
d: who loved the house of prayer

p: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered
a: through the prophesying of Haggai
s: the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
d: by the commandment of the elders
with holy rejoicing of the priests
under the decree of the king

p: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was
a: a ready scribe
s: in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.

a: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers
s: , which hath put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem:
d: Great is the glory of the God of Jacob
Praise ye the name of the holy One
Give thanks unto the King of heaven

p: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was strengthened as

the tender mercy of our King
the ancient promise of our fathers

s: , and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

d: our secret transgressions are revealed before thee
our unrighteous deeds have provoked thy anger
we have turned aside from thy holy commandment

s: : for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.
d: O King of heaven, thy name is holy

God of our fathers, thy mercy endureth

p: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and

give me understanding in thy holy statutes
